headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 2, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers took a thrilling 10-9 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance. The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Sandy Alcantara earned the win for the Marlins. The Kansas City Royals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-2 victory, with Lane Thomas leading the Royals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 4 runs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Welinton Herrera being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation for the Colorado Rockies. Robert Garcia was also transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list for the Texas Rangers. Chris Martin was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, with right shoulder impingement for the Texas Rangers. Other injured players include Carlos Santana (strained right adductor for the Arizona Diamondbacks), Joel Peguero (left hamstring strain for the San Francisco Giants), Griffin Conine (left hamstring strain for the Miami Marlins), Andrew Nardi (left rib cage stress reaction for the Miami Marlins), and Josh Ekness (right calf strain for the Miami Marlins).

The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Lawrence joining the Twins in exchange for cash considerations. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Thrilling 10-9 Win Over Rays**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Tampa Bay Rays in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 10-9 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Sandy Alcantara earned the win for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Reds 9-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-2 victory. Lane Thomas led the Royals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down White Sox 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Joe Ryan earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 4 earned runs. Miguel Vargas led the White Sox offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies' Welinton Herrera Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-handed pitcher Welinton Herrera has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Justin Lawrence in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. Lawrence joins the Twins in exchange for cash considerations.
